narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Six times four is twenty four, so the number is always divisible by twenty four.
<bookmark mark='twelve'/>Look at twelve. It is divisible by six, and it is divisible by four.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Twelve is not divisible by twenty four, so that rule breaks.
